content.text: The insurance clause fully meets the preferred position.

input.quote: Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18.1 obliges Vendor (Copperleaf) to carry CGL at USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, cyber/privacy at USD 5M and workers' compensation as required by law, for the term plus one year — matching the preferred position in full (and exceeding the fallback). Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance on request, reputable insurers, notice of cancellation, and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. No redline needed; all obligations run against the counterparty.
